metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented the C++20 iCalendar tool in `output/` with the required CLI:

- Build: `cmake -B output/build -S output && cmake --build output/build`
- Executable: `output/build/ical`
- Commands:
  - `ical parse --input <path.ics> --output <out.json>`
  - `ical expand --input <path.ics> --from <ISO-8601> --to <ISO-8601> --output <out.json>`

Key files:
- `output/CMakeLists.txt`
- `output/src/main.cpp`
- `output/src/ical.hpp`, `output/src/ical.cpp` (lexing/unfolding, component tree, param decoding)
- `output/src/rrule.hpp`, `output/src/rrule.cpp` (RRULE parsing)
- `output/src/tz.hpp`, `output/src/tz.cpp` (basic VTIMEZONE parsing + local→UTC handling with fold/gap warnings)
- `output/src/expand.hpp`, `output/src/expand.cpp` (JSON schema emission + expansion)
- `output/src/json.hpp`, `output/src/json.cpp` (JSON writer)
- `output/src/datetime.hpp`, `output/src/datetime.cpp` (date/time/offset utilities)
- `output/src/text.hpp`, `output/src/text.cpp` (TEXT unescape + RFC6868 param decode)

If you want, I can add a small `output/README.md` with usage examples and known limitations of the current recurrence/timezone expander.
